records.jp: クイーンのコアを、身体に埋め込む……だと？<CR>それは本当なのか！
records.en_original: Implanting a Queen's core into your body? Are you serious?!
records.en: Implanting a Queen's core into your body?<CR>Are you serious?!

records.jp: 確かに、詩はそう言った。<CR>そうすることで、イローデッドは最強の存在になれると
records.en_original: Yeah, that's what Uta said. She believes doing that will morph the Eroded into their strongest form.
records.en: Yeah, that's what Uta said.<CR>She believes doing that will morph the Eroded into their strongest form.

records.jp: そんなの……どの文献でも見たことない
records.en_original: I've never read about anything like that in any documents.
records.en: I've never read about anything like that in any documents.

records.jp: こんなこと吹き込んで、駒川さんはいったい何を<CR>考えてるの……？
records.en_original: What is Uta trying to do, filling people's heads with stuff like this?
records.en: What is Komagawa-san trying to do, filling people's heads<CR>with stuff like this?

records.jp: 何か目的があって<CR>部隊を瓦解させようとしているのかもしれない
records.en_original: Maybe she's trying to tear our squad apart for some reason.
records.en: Maybe she's<CR>trying to tear our squad apart for some reason.

records.jp: ……詩の心は、何故か読めない。<CR>すまぬ、力になれなくて
records.en_original: I don't know why, but I can't read Uta's mind. Sorry, I can't be much help.
records.en: I don't know why, but I can't read Uta's mind.<CR>Sorry, I can't be much help.

records.jp: ううん、充分だよきらら。ありがとう
records.en_original: No, you've done more than enough, Kirara. Thank you.
records.en: No, you've done more than enough, Kirara. Thank you.

records.jp: しかし、どうして私に相談したんだ？<CR>こういう相談は、リーダーにするべきだと思うが……
records.en_original: But, why did you come to me? Wouldn't this be something you should talk to the leader about?
records.en: But, why did you come to me?<CR>Wouldn't this be something you should talk to the leader about?

records.jp: リーダーの近くは、詩の目が光っていた。<CR>相談しようにも、邪魔されるのは確実
records.en_original: Uta was always watching near the leader. She'd definitely interfere if I tried to talk to him.
records.en: Uta was always watching near the leader.<CR>She'd definitely interfere if I tried to talk to him.

records.jp: リーダーの次に頼りになるのは、美岐。<CR>だから相談に来た
records.en_original: After Leader, you're the next most dependable, Meiqi. That's why I came to you.
records.en: After Leader, you're the next most dependable, Meiqi.<CR>That's why I came to you.

records.jp: そうか……。<CR>相談してくれてありがとう、きらら
records.en_original: I see... Thanks for coming to me, Kirara.
records.en: I see...<CR>Thanks for coming to me, Kirara.

records.jp: けど、本当にあいつ何考えてるんだろ？<CR>なんかわけわからな過ぎて不気味なんだけど
records.en_original: But seriously, what is she thinking? The more I try to figure it out, the scarier it gets.
records.en: But seriously, what is she thinking?<CR>The more I try to figure it out, the scarier it gets.

records.jp: 由紀子も、詩が怖いのか？
records.en_original: Yukiko, are you scared of Uta too?
records.en: Yukiko, are you scared of Uta too?

records.jp: ……わかっちゃうか。<CR>きららは心を読めるんだもんね
records.en_original: You can tell, huh? I almost forgot you can read minds, Kirara.
records.en: You can tell, huh?<CR>I almost forgot you can read minds, Kirara.

records.jp: 実は私、出雲に来る前に<CR>駒川さんと関わったことがあって
records.en_original: Actually, before I came to Izumo, I had some dealings with Uta.
records.en: Actually, before I came to Izumo,<CR>I had some dealings with Komagawa-san.

records.jp: その時、フラグメントを抜かれそうになったの
records.en_original: Back then, she almost took my Fragment.
records.en: Back then, she almost took my Fragment.

records.jp: そうだったのか！？
records.en_original: Wait, really?!
records.en: Wait, really?!

records.jp: ネット上でやり取りしてたから、直接会ったのは<CR>この前が初めてだったんだけどね
records.en_original: Since we'd only talked online, we only met for the first time after she came here, though.
records.en: Since we'd only talked online, we only met<CR>for the first time after she came here, though.

records.jp: 他の子にもそういうことをしてたって友達に<CR>聞かされてたから、危険な人だってことはわかってた
records.en_original: My friends told me she'd done things like that with other girls too, so I already knew she was dangerous.
records.en: My friends told me she'd done things like that with other girls too,<CR>so I already knew she was dangerous.

records.jp: でも、出雲に来てからはしてないっぽいし……<CR>明確に悪いことをしてる素振りは見せてなかった
records.en_original: But, ever since coming to Izumo, it seems like she hasn't done anything. She hasn't really shown any clear signs of doing bad things.
records.en: But it doesn't look like she's done anything since coming to Izumo...<CR>She hasn't shown any obvious signs of doing anything bad.

records.jp: きららのことも、駒川さんがしたんじゃないかって<CR>薄々思ってたけど、証拠が掴めなくて――
records.en_original: I sort of suspected that Uta might've done something to you too, Kirara, but I couldn't get any proof.
records.en: I sort of suspected that Komagawa-san might've done<CR>something to you too, Kirara, but I couldn't get any proof.

records.jp: ……いや、嘘。ただ怖かっただけ。<CR>駒川さんにまた目をつけられて、復讐されるのが
records.en_original: ...No, that's a lie. I was just scared. Scared that Uta would target me again and get revenge.
records.en: ...No, that's a lie. I was just scared.<CR>Scared that Komagawa-san would target me again and get revenge.

records.jp: ごめん。私が早くきららに……ううん、みんなに<CR>伝えてればこんなことには……
records.en_original: I'm sorry... If I'd only told you—no, everyone—sooner, none of this would've happened.
records.en: I'm sorry... If I'd only told you—no, everyone—sooner,<CR>none of this would've happened.

records.jp: 由紀子が謝ることじゃない
records.en_original: Yukiko, you don't have anything to apologize for.
records.en: Yukiko, you don't have anything to apologize for.

records.jp: 詩の恐ろしさは、きららもわかる。<CR>きららも何度、圧をかけられたことか
records.en_original: I understand how scary Uta can be. She's put pressure on me many times before.
records.en: Kirara understands how scary Uta can be.<CR>Uta has put pressure on Kirara more than once.

records.jp: けど、詩が悪事を働いたという決定的証拠が<CR>ないから、動けないのだ
records.en_original: But since there's no definite proof that Uta did anything wrong, we can't take action.
records.en: But since there's no definite proof that Uta did anything wrong,<CR>we can't take action.

records.jp: きらら、私考えがあるんだけど
records.en_original: Kirara, I have an idea...
records.en: Kirara, I have an idea...

records.jp: あらあら……久野さん言っちゃったんですか～？<CR>一応、二人だけの内緒話のつもりでしたのに
records.en_original: Oh my, Kirara spilled the beans? I thought it was just our little secret.
records.en: Oh my, Kuno-san spilled the beans?<CR>I thought it was just our little secret.

records.jp: けど、おかげで由紀姫先生と二人きりになる機会が<CR>できたから、久野さんには感謝ですね～♡
records.en_original: But thanks to her, I got a chance to be alone with Princess Yuki. I should be grateful to Kirara!
records.en: But thanks to her, I got a chance to be alone with Princess Yuki.<CR>I should be grateful to Kuno-san!

records.jp: 相変わらず今も続けてるみたいですね、恋愛相談。<CR>ネットの中だけじゃなくて、リアルでも
records.en_original: You're still giving love advice, huh? Not just online, but in real life too.
records.en: You're still giving love advice, huh?<CR>Not just online, but in real life too.

records.jp: 良かったですね～経験が生きて
records.en_original: Looks like your experience really paid off. Good for you.
records.en: Looks like your experience really paid off. Good for you.

records.jp: 私が知ってることに驚かないんですね。<CR>面と向かってお話したことはなかったと思いますが
records.en_original: You're not surprised that I know about this. I don't think I've ever talked to you face to face before.
records.en: You're not surprised that I know about this.<CR>I don't think I've ever talked to you face to face before.

records.jp: 誰かから教えてもらったんですか？　<CR>……まぁ、どうでもいいですけど
records.en_original: Did someone tell you? Well, I guess it doesn't really matter.
records.en: Did someone tell you?<CR>Well, I guess it doesn't really matter.

records.jp: 揺さぶりをかけようとしてるのかもしれないけど、<CR>もうそういう段階の話じゃない
records.en_original: Maybe you're trying to shake me, but we're way past that point.
records.en: Maybe you're trying to shake me,<CR>but we're way past that point.

records.jp: チームの瓦解か、それ以外の目的かはわからないけど、<CR>みんなを傷つけるようなことは……絶対にさせない
records.en_original: Whether your goal is to break up the team or something else, I'll never let you hurt everyone.
records.en: Whether your goal is to break up the team or something else,<CR>I'll never let you hurt everyone.

records.jp: へ～、覚悟を決めたんですね。<CR>えらいえら～い
records.en_original: Wow, so you've made up your mind. Good for you.
records.en: Wow, so you've made up your mind.<CR>Good for you.

records.jp: でも、残念。<CR>覚悟だけで人を救うことはできないんです
records.en_original: But sorry. Having resolve alone won't save anyone.
records.en: But sorry.<CR>Having resolve alone won't save anyone.

records.jp: 私は本部から派遣されてきた。<CR>それがどういう意味かわかりますよね？
records.en_original: I was sent here by headquarters. You know what that means, right?
records.en: I was sent here by headquarters.<CR>You know what that means, right?

records.jp: 能力的にも立場的にも劣るあなたが<CR>私に挑んだところで、歯が立つわけないでしょう？
records.en_original: If you challenge me, someone who's weaker both in ability and position, there's no way you can win, you know?
records.en: If you challenge me, someone who's weaker both in ability<CR>and position, there's no way you can win, you know?

records.jp: さあ……それはどうかな？
records.en_original: Well... I wonder about that.
records.en: Well... I wonder about that.

records.jp: あらあら、いつのまに。<CR>応援がいたなんて気づきませんでした～
records.en_original: My my, when did this happen? I didn't even notice you had backup.
records.en: My my, when did this happen?<CR>I didn't even notice you had backup.

records.jp: 御託はいい。<CR>駒川、お前の狙いを話してもらうぞ
records.en_original: Cut the small talk. Tell me what you're really after, Uta.
records.en: Cut the small talk.<CR>Tell me what you're really after, Uta.

records.jp: 狙いも何も、私の目的は皆さんとの共闘。<CR>これは嘘じゃありません
records.en_original: There's nothing to hide—my only goal is to work together with all of you. I'm not lying about that.
records.en: There's nothing to hide—my only goal is to work together with all of you.<CR>I'm not lying about that.

records.jp: クイーンのコアを埋め込むよう言っておきながら、<CR>まだそんなことを
records.en_original: You say that even after telling us to implant a Queen's core?
records.en: You say that even after telling us to implant<CR>a Queen's core?

records.jp: 皆さんの力を必要としてるのは、本当なんです。<CR>なぜなら……
records.en_original: It's true—I really do need your help. Because...
records.en: It's true—I really do need your help.<CR>Because...

records.jp: あなたたちイローデッドは全員――
records.en_original: All of you Eroded—
records.en: All of you Eroded—

records.jp: 素晴らしい力を秘めた存在、<CR>クイーンになることができるからです♪
records.en_original: Each of you holds incredible power, and you can all become Queens!
records.en: Each of you holds incredible power,<CR>and you can all become Queens!

records.jp: けれどもイローデッド単体では、異灰化の度合が<CR>進むにつれ、正気を失っていってしまう
records.en_original: But on your own, as an Eroded, the more you turn into a Testa, the more you lose your sanity.
records.en: But on your own, as an Eroded, the more you turn into a Testa,<CR>the more you lose your sanity.

records.jp: 私たちはそんなイローデッドの欠点を<CR>補うことができる。すなわち――
records.en_original: We can make up for that weakness in Eroded. In other words...
records.en: We can make up for that weakness Eroded have.<CR>In other words—

records.jp: “安全”に、クイーンという最強の異灰になれるよう<CR>サポートすることができる、というわけです
records.en_original: We can help you safely become the strongest Testa. Become Queens.
records.en: We can support you so you can safely become<CR>Queens—the strongest Testa.

records.jp: その方法が……<CR>クイーンのコアを身体に埋め込むということか
records.en_original: And that method...is to embed the Queen's core in our bodies?
records.en: And that method...is to embed<CR>the Queen's core in our bodies?

records.jp: 異灰には異灰、<CR>それも最強の“クイーン”で対抗……ってこと？
records.en_original: So it's Testa versus Testa, and you're using the strongest one, the Queen, to fight back... Is that it?
records.en: So it's Testa versus Testa,<CR>and you're using the strongest one, the Queen, to fight back... Is that it?

records.jp: ですですっ！<CR>皆さん、どうしますかっ？
records.en_original: Exactly! So, what will you all do?
records.en: Exactly!<CR>So, what will you all do?

records.jp: 誰でも……もちろん全員だったら<CR>最高にウェルカムですっ！
records.en_original: Anyone is welcome. Of course, if all of you joined, that would be absolutely perfect!
records.en: Anyone... Of course,<CR>I'd be absolutely thrilled if all of you joined!

records.jp: ……共闘するか、しないか。<CR>答える前に、１つ聞きたい事があるんだけど？
records.en_original: So we either fight together or against each other? Before I answer, there's something I have to ask.
records.en: So we either fight together or against each other?<CR>Before I answer, there's something I have to ask.

records.jp: ……なんですか？
records.en_original: What is it?
records.en: What is it?

records.jp: 倉持や樹里、それ以外のクイーンも全部……、<CR>あれをやったのは……あんたたち？
records.en_original: Ami, Juri, all the other Queens... Was it you who did that?
records.en: Ami, Juri, all the other Queens...<CR>Was it you who did that?

records.jp: ……そうです、と言ったら？
records.en_original: ...What if I said yes?
records.en: ...What if I said yes?

records.jp: 絶対に、許さない
records.en_original: Simple. I'd never forgive you.
records.en: Simple. I'd never forgive you.

records.jp: きゃ～っ、どうしよぅ～！<CR>ゾクゾクする～～っ♪
records.en_original: Oh my! What should I do?! This is so exciting!
records.en: Oh my! What should I do?!<CR>This is so exciting!

records.jp: 許さないって～、<CR>私、どうされちゃうんですかっ？　ねえねえっ！
records.en_original: If you won't forgive me, what are you going to do to me? C'mon, tell me!
records.en: If you won't forgive me,<CR>what are you going to do to me? C'mon, tell me!

records.jp: ふざけんな！！
records.en_original: Don't mess around!
records.en: Don't mess around!

records.jp: や～ん、大胆♡<CR>でも、ちょっとがっつきすぎですよ
records.en_original: Oh, wow, so bold! But you're coming on a bit too strong.
records.en: Oh, wow, so bold!<CR>But you're coming on a bit too strong.

records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: じっくり、たっぷり楽しみましょう。ね？
records.en_original: Let's take our time and really enjoy this, okay?
records.en: Let's take our time and really enjoy this, okay?
